text: No, the whole property was not cleared in 2021. Only about 2.23% of the property, equivalent to 81.3 hectares, experienced tree-cover loss in that year. The majority of this loss occurred in planted forests, with 68.1 hectares of Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda being cleared. Additionally, there was some loss in patches under 0.5 hectares, totaling 37.3 hectares, which was not counted as a significant event. The property remained largely forested, with only a small portion being deforested.
